I ran a paired t-test on the days above 90°F, comparing 2018 with 1948 at the same 197 stations. A paired test fits because each station appears in both years.

The test gives t = 2.37 with 196 degrees of freedom (p ≈ 0.019). That is evidence of a difference in the average number of days above 90°F between the two years.

For comparison, treating the two years as independent samples (Welch's test) gives t = 0.82. I used the paired version because the data are matched by station.

ANSWER: 2.37
